Easy Archive is a private app for securely keeping your photos, files, document scans, notes, and contacts — everything is stored only on your phone, never on a server or the internet.

Create a new folder with the + button and pick one of eight pastel colors. Each folder card also shows how many items are inside.

To lock a folder: long-press it or tap its three-dot menu → "Lock folder". From the same menu you can change its password or remove the lock.

Forgot a folder's password? Tap "Forgot folder password" while opening it and answer the two security questions (set up in advance in Settings) — you'll immediately set a new password.

Inside a folder, the + button offers four options: add photos or videos (multiple at once), add a file, scan a document with the camera, or write a text note.

Tapping an item: photos open full-screen with zoom and swipe between the folder's other photos, videos play with a built-in player, notes open read-only (with a pencil icon to edit, and swipe between the folder's other notes), and files/scans open in a suitable app on your phone.

Long-press to enter multi-select mode. Each item's menu offers pin, favorite, rename, duplicate, share, save to device (at full original quality), or delete.
Favorited items (from any folder) are collected under "Favorites". Deleted items go to Trash first and are automatically removed after 30 days — you can restore them before then.
Create time-based reminders, optionally link them to a specific folder, and repeat them yearly if you like.
A phonebook separate from your phone\'s contacts, kept only inside the app: add a contact with name, number, email, and note; search; call or message directly; mark favorites.

Light/dark/system theme and background color (one of eight pastel colors, or white) live under "Appearance". Instead of a color, you can also pick a clear photo from your own gallery as the background — shared across every screen (home, settings, favorites, trash, reminders, contacts). Folder card size (1/2/3 columns) can be changed with the icon next to the search bar on the home screen. Switch language (11 available) with the 🌍 button on the home screen.\n\nSecurity: app-wide numeric password lock plus a security question, fingerprint unlock, screenshot blocking, and setting the two folder-recovery answers.

"Export all data": choose a password for the file and it builds one encrypted file you can send anywhere (email, Drive, Telegram).\n\n"Restore from backup file": pick the file and enter its password; everything replaces your current data. After restoring, be sure to fully close and reopen the app.
For any question or issue, tap "Contact support" on this screen or reach out at Newlifetech25@hotmail.com.

Since you haven\'t set an app-wide password yet, you\'ll need a separate password just for this backup file. Note: this password has no recovery option — if you forget it, the file becomes permanently unreadable. We recommend turning on "Lock with password" in Settings first.
